subject: Tenant tagging gap: unbilled token pool and VAT split
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@atlas-labs.com>
To: billing@redwood.ai
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T08:15:00+01:00
Subject: Tenant tagging gap and unbilled tokens for July ingest

Hi team,

We discovered an allocation gap on our July ingest window. A subset of our batch uploads between 2026-07-12 and 2026-07-14 were missing tenant tags and ended up in the shared untagged pool. That resulted in those token counts being attributed to other tenants in our org and not appearing on our July invoice.

Attached is a small sample of raw logs showing the missing tenant_id on impacted requests (sample-logs.csv) and our July invoice (invoice_2026-07.pdf) for reference. The unknown pool shows about 12k tokens during that window but your billing output lists 0 for our tenant. Can you confirm whether those tokens should have been billed to Atlas Labs and if VAT will be recalculated?

We need an explanation and proposed adjustment before our accounting close next week. Please cc finance at ap@atlas-labs.com on the resolution.

Thanks,
Sasha Patel
Head of Platform
Atlas Labs
[Attachment: sample-logs.csv (CSV, 24KB)]
[Attachment: invoice_2026-07.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@atlas-labs.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Tenant tagging gap and unbilled tokens for July ingest

Hi Sasha,

Thanks for flagging this and for the sample files. I am opening an internal investigation now. Initial ask: could you confirm the exact project_id and the time window you expect us to attribute to Atlas Labs so we can run an attribution job? From what you attached, the likely window is 2026-07-12 02:00 to 2026-07-14 23:59 UTC but I want to be precise.

Ive looped in Vanessa from Billing to handle credits and Karhtik from Runtime to run the token re-attribution and provide counts and raw evidence.

We will aim to provide a proposed invoice adjustment and VAT recalculation by tomorrow close of business.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Customer Billing
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

Date: 2026-10-20T10:15:00+01:00

Forwarding Sasha's report. Karhtik, can you run the re-attribution for project_id atlas-prod, window 2026-07-12T02:00Z to 2026-07-14T23:59Z and confirm:

- Total tokens in untagged pool matching Atlas request patterns
- Token breakdown by day
- Whether any tokens were double-counted across retries or duplicate request_ids

Vanessa, please prepare a draft credit calculation with VAT delta. Sasha asked for finance to be looped in, so we should include gross and net numbers and an updated invoice link.

Thanks,
Irene

On 2026-10-20 10:03, Irene Choi wrote:
> Thanks for flagging this and for the sample files...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@atlas-labs.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T14:28:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Tenant tagging gap and unbilled tokens for July ingest

Hi all,

I ran the attribution against the raw request logs. Summary:

- Window: 2026-07-12T02:00Z to 2026-07-14T23:59Z
- Candidate untagged requests matching Atlas patterns: 12,430 tokens total
- Day breakdown: 2026-07-12 = 3,210; 2026-07-13 = 6,900; 2026-07-14 = 2,320
- Root cause: intermittent client SDK that failed to set tenant_id on retry path for large multipart uploads; no double-count detected, each request has unique request_id

Attached is the attribution report which includes request ids and timestamps (attribution-report.csv). My recommendation is a pro-rata credit for the 12,430 tokens plus VAT reversal for the charged party. At current unit rate for Atlas plan thats approx eur 134.20 before VAT.

I also note that the untagged pool was consumed by Tenant B during that window which explains why Atlas shows zero for those days.

I will queue a job to tag those historical entries for auditability but not to retroactively re-run usage ingestion. A billing adjustment is the correct remediation.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: attribution-report.csv (CSV, 48KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@atlas-labs.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T16:42:00+01:00
Subject: Credit applied and adjusted invoice link for Atlas Labs (July window)

Hi Sasha and AP team,

Thanks for your patience. Based on Karthik's attribution we applied a billing adjustment to reassign the 12,430 tokens to Atlas Labs and issued a credit for eur 134.20 net. VAT at 20 percent was recalculated and reversed where applicable. The net credit applied to your account is eur 160.64.

Adjusted invoice and credit memo are available here: https://invoices.redwood.ai/adjustments/ATL-2026-09-88-01 (internal link). A PDF copy of the credit memo is attached.

We also put a note on the account to ignore the earlier zero token line for that date range. Let me know if you need a journal entry or SAP-formatted statement for your close.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: billing-adjustment-draft.pdf (PDF, 56KB)]
